article.story: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. -- — Jeremy Elyzee had 16 points and 13 rebounds in UAB’s 102-62 victory over Division II's Auburn Montgomery on Friday. Elyzee also had five assists and three steals for the Blazers (5-3). Elijah Duval also scored 16, adding five rebounds and three steals. Justyn Fernandez had 15 points and went 7 of 10 from the field. RJ Williams led the Warhawks with 12 points. Devon McKinnon and Legend Martin both scored 10. UAB took the lead for good with 16:14 remaining in the first half. The score was 44-35 at halftime, with Elyzee racking up 12 points. Up next: UAB hosts Samford in its next matchup on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
